title: potentilla recta var. laciniosa
intro: Potentilla recta var. laciniosa, commonly known as the Five-leafed Potentilla, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family, characterized by its unique five-leafed foliage and clusters of small yellow flowers. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce pain and swelling, and potentially lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla recta var. laciniosa include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, tannins, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its therapeutic properties, and further research is needed to fully understand its potential health benefits and applications.
